1: // game.js - Simple Pixel Dodger
2: // Canvas with id "game" assumed in HTML.
3: 
4: (() => {
5:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
6:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
7:   const width = canvas.width;
8:   const height = canvas.height;
9: 
10:   // Player ship
11:   const ship = { x: width / 2 - 10, y: height - 30, size: 20, speed: 4, shield: 0 };
12: 
13:   // Input handling
14:   const keys = {};
15:   window.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => (keys[e.key] = true));
16:   window.addEventListener('keyup', (e) => (keys[e.key] = false));
17: 
18:   // Game objects
19:   const asteroids = [];
20:   const powerUps = [];
21:   let lastAsteroid = 0;
22:   let lastPower = 0;
23:   let score = 0;
24:   let startTime = performance.now();
25:   let gameOver = false;
26:   // Audio context and helper
27:   const audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
28:   function playSound(freq, dur) {
29:     const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
30:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
31:     osc.frequency.value = freq;
32:     osc.type = 'sine';
33:     osc.connect(gain);
34:     gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
35:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.05, audioCtx.currentTime);
36:     osc.start();
37:     osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + dur);
38:   }
39: 
40:   function spawnAsteroid() {
41:     const size = 15 + Math.random() * 15;
42:     asteroids.push({ x: Math.random() * (width - size), y: -size, size, speed: 2 + Math.random() * 2 });
43:     playSound(120, 0.08); // asteroid spawn beep
44:   }
45: 
46:   function spawnPower() {
47:     const size = 12;
48:     powerUps.push({ x: Math.random() * (width - size), y: -size, size, speed: 2 });
49:   }
50: 
51:   function update(dt) {
52:     // Move ship
53:     if (keys.ArrowLeft) ship.x -= ship.speed;
54:     if (keys.ArrowRight) ship.x += ship.speed;
55:     if (keys.ArrowUp) ship.y -= ship.speed;
56:     if (keys.ArrowDown) ship.y += ship.speed;
57:     // keep inside bounds
58:     ship.x = Math.max(0, Math.min(width - ship.size, ship.x));
59:     ship.y = Math.max(0, Math.min(height - ship.size, ship.y));
60: 
61:     // Spawn asteroids every 800ms
62:     if (performance.now() - lastAsteroid > 800) { spawnAsteroid(); lastAsteroid = performance.now(); }
63:     // Spawn power‑up every 8000ms
64:     if (performance.now() - lastPower > 8000) { spawnPower(); lastPower = performance.now(); }
65: 
66:     // Update asteroids
67:     for (let i = asteroids.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
68:       const a = asteroids[i];
69:       a.y += a.speed;
70:       if (a.y > height) asteroids.splice(i, 1);
71:     }
72:     // Update power‑ups
73:     for (let i = powerUps.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
74:       const p = powerUps[i];
75:       p.y += p.speed;
76:       if (p.y > height) powerUps.splice(i, 1);
77:     }
78: 
79:     // Collision detection
80:     for (let i = asteroids.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
81:       const a = asteroids[i];
82:       if (rectIntersect(ship, a)) {
83:         if (ship.shield > 0) {
84:           // destroy asteroid, consume shield
85:           asteroids.splice(i, 1);
86:           ship.shield--;
87:         } else {
88:           playSound(200, 0.3); // collision beep
89:           gameOver = true;
90:         }
91:         break;
92:       }
93:     }
94:     for (let i = powerUps.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
95:       const p = powerUps[i];
96:       if (rectIntersect(ship, p)) {
97:         ship.shield = 3; // grant 3‑frame shield
98:         powerUps.splice(i, 1);
99:         break;
100:       }
101:     }
102: 
103:     // Score based on survival time
104:     score = Math.floor((performance.now() - startTime) / 1000);
105:   }
106: 
107:   function rectIntersect(a, b) {
108:     return a.x < b.x + b.size && a.x + a.size > b.x && a.y < b.y + b.size && a.y + a.size > b.y;
109:   }
110: 
111:   function draw() {
112:     // background: dark space with tiny stars
113:     ctx.fillStyle = '#000020';
114:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
115:     drawStarfield();
116: 
117:     // ship as triangle, colored cyan when shielded
118:     ctx.fillStyle = ship.shield > 0 ? '#00ffff' : '#ffffff';
119:     ctx.beginPath();
120:     ctx.moveTo(ship.x + ship.size / 2, ship.y);
121:     ctx.lineTo(ship.x, ship.y + ship.size);
122:     ctx.lineTo(ship.x + ship.size, ship.y + ship.size);
123:     ctx.closePath();
124:     ctx.fill();
125: 
126:     // asteroids as radial gradient circles
127:     asteroids.forEach(a => {
128:       const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(
129:         a.x + a.size / 2, a.y + a.size / 2, a.size * 0.2,
130:         a.x + a.size / 2, a.y + a.size / 2, a.size / 2
131:       );
132:       grad.addColorStop(0, '#777777');
133:       grad.addColorStop(1, '#222222');
134:       ctx.fillStyle = grad;
135:       ctx.beginPath();
136:       ctx.arc(a.x + a.size / 2, a.y + a.size / 2, a.size / 2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
137:       ctx.fill();
138:     });
139: 
140:     // power‑ups as rotating stars
141:     ctx.fillStyle = '#ffdd00';
142:     powerUps.forEach(p => {
143:       const cx = p.x + p.size / 2;
144:       const cy = p.y + p.size / 2;
145:       const spikes = 5;
146:       const outer = p.size / 2;
147:       const inner = outer / 2.5;
148:       ctx.save();
149:       ctx.translate(cx, cy);
150:       ctx.rotate(performance.now() / 500);
151:       ctx.beginPath();
152:       for (let i = 0; i < spikes * 2; i++) {
153:         const r = i % 2 === 0 ? outer : inner;
154:         const angle = (i * Math.PI) / spikes;
155:         ctx.lineTo(r * Math.cos(angle), r * Math.sin(angle));
156:       }
157:       ctx.closePath();
158:       ctx.fill();
159:       ctx.restore();
160:     });
161: 
162:     // score
163:     ctx.fillStyle = '#00ff00';
164:     ctx.font = '16px monospace';
165:     ctx.fillText('Score: ' + score, 10, 20);
166:     // shield indicator
167:     if (ship.shield > 0) {
168:       ctx.fillText('Shield: ' + ship.shield, 10, 40);
169:     }
170:   }
171: 
172: // helper: simple moving starfield
173: const starfield = [];
174: for (let i = 0; i < 100; i++) {
175:   starfield.push({ x: Math.random() * width, y: Math.random() * height, size: Math.random() * 2 + 1, speed: Math.random() * 0.5 + 0.2 });
176: }
177: function drawStarfield() {
178:   ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
179:   starfield.forEach(s => {
180:     ctx.fillRect(s.x, s.y, s.size, s.size);
181:     s.y += s.speed;
182:     if (s.y > height) { s.y = 0; s.x = Math.random() * width; }
183:   });
184: }
185: 
186:   function loop(timestamp) {
187:     if (gameOver) {
188:       ctx.fillStyle = 'black';
189:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
190:       ctx.fillStyle = 'red';
191:       ctx.font = '24px monospace';
192:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', width / 2 - 60, height / 2);
193:       ctx.fillStyle = 'white';
194:       ctx.fillText('Final Score: ' + score, width / 2 - 70, height / 2 + 30);
195:       return;
196:     }
197:     const dt = timestamp - (lastFrame || timestamp);
198:     lastFrame = timestamp;
199:     update(dt);
200:     draw();
